story_type: uncrewed capsule misses its orbit, lands on airbags in the desert
hook: It missed its orbit. Now it had to land in the dark.
narration: This spacecraft was falling through the desert sky under three parachutes.
It was Boeing's Starliner, launched with no one aboard.
But it never reached its planned orbit, so it could not dock with the space station.
Starliner comes down on land, so airbags under the capsule soften the touchdown.
[short pause] It came down at White Sands Space Harbor in New Mexico.
outcome: Starliner settled gently onto its airbags, the first land touchdown of a human-rated capsule in U.S. history.

location_card.place: White Sands Space Harbor, New Mexico

preview_ok: Infrared descent shots are a black night sky with the white capsule and parachutes clearly in frame; DARK flags the sky, not the subject.
title: Starliner lands on airbags in the dark
description:
Boeing's uncrewed CST-100 Starliner lands at White Sands Space Harbor, New Mexico, Dec. 22, 2019, after its Orbital Flight Test did not reach its planned orbit.
